title: Move Don't Delete
style: 96 BPM dark hip-hop, sparse 808, brushed snares, spoken-word verses, single low piano, breath-driven, honest delivery, dramatic chorus only at the end, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — piano, breath, no drum]
(breath)
Three rules.
Move don't delete.
ZynAsk before assume.
Check before you move.

[Verse 1 — sparse 808 enters]
Underscore TO underscore DELETE — that was the path.
Not rm dash rf. Not the axe. Not the wrath.
Move first, verify, then let it go.
The doctrine knew. I should have known.
Logic without consent is a stranger in your home.

[Verse 2 — brushed snares]
ALPHA SAFE EMERGENCY — fourteen gig stayed.
The local original — fifteen gig made.
Eight point eight — that one I cannot bring back.
The canonical wrap is whole. The partials are the crack.

[Bridge — piano alone]
Move don't delete.
Move don't delete.
Three words. One rule.
The next session reads it
before it repeats the move.

[Chorus — dramatic, end of song]
Move don't delete —
write it on the wall.
Move don't delete —
write it on the call.
ZynAsk before assume,
check before you move,
move don't delete —
that's the groove.

[Outro — breath, piano fades]
The factory still runs.
The next file is yours.
McIvor.
(breath)
